inputs.text: Use the input image as the identity source. Preserve the same fictional adult brunette UGC model: oval face, warm light skin, natural freckles, brown eyes, thick dark eyebrows, straight natural nose, full pink lips, soft warm smile, shoulder-length wavy brown hair with subtle highlights, natural skin texture, white or cream outfit, clean bright room lighting. Use the input image as the body and pose source. Create a silent vertical 9:16 full-body UGC movement test. Setting: bright clean bathroom or vanity corner, soft daylight, white tile, skincare routine mood. Outfit: same outfit as the input still, no wardrobe change. Keep the whole body visible from head to shoes at the start. Movement must include legs, hips, shoulders, arms, head, and natural weight shift, not only face movement. Product may be held at chest level, but do not try to recreate label text. No speech mouth, no sudden camera zoom, no warped legs, no broken fingers, no scene change.
